functional_reproduction.notes: EXECUTED in this env (Python 3.12, torch 2.4.1+cpu, transformers 4.44.2 all present). `python main.py --mode evaluate` runs pure-stdlib and prints REAL computed metrics on real inputs (F1@3=0.444, BLEU=22.721, BP=0.457, ROUGE-L=0.595, NTED=0.344 with edit_distance=18.58 nodes_a=20 nodes_b=34) — genuinely computed, no hardcoding. `python main.py --mode gen-ingredients` ran a REAL GPT-2 forward pass on CPU and produced novel neural text ('Add 1 cup soy sauce, 1/3 cup corn syrup...') conditioned on the verbatim multi-field prompt, then ran the live F1 mini-eval. Core method (bidirectional multi-field conditional generation + Zhang-Shasha NTED) is real code, not mockup. -2: the flagship fine-tuned RecipeGPT weights are unavailable (authors never released), so generation uses base gpt2 (honestly labeled STAND-IN); output is generic, not on-topic recipes.
